description: This file implements a WebRTC client controller in Go, facilitating peer-to-peer connections, signaling, ICE candidate handling, and connection state management within a WebRTC-based application.

classes.name: Signaling
classes.description: Holds signaling channels, ICE servers, and client ICE servers for WebRTC connection establishment.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages WebRTC peer connection lifecycle, signaling, and state changes.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Interface for handling peer connection events such as data channel addition, errors, failures, and closure.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a WebRTC connection with methods to manage its lifecycle.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebRTC connection and handles connection state changes.

methods.name: recvLoop
methods.description: Listens for signaling messages from the channel and processes them accordingly.

methods.name: stopGoRoutines
methods.description: Stops the signaling goroutines by closing channels.

methods.name: closeSendCh
methods.description: Safely closes the send channel in the controller.

methods.name: sendSigMsg
methods.description: Sends signaling messages through the send channel, respecting its closure state.

methods.name: onOffer
methods.description: Handles an incoming WebRTC offer, sets remote description, and creates an answer.

methods.name: onAnswer
methods.description: Handles an incoming answer and sets it as the remote description.

methods.name: onICECandidate
methods.description: Adds an ICE candidate received from the remote peer.

methods.name: sendICECandidate
methods.description: Sends an ICE candidate via signaling.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new WebRTC connection with default logger configuration.

methods.name: NewConnectionWithLogger
methods.description: Creates a new WebRTC connection with a custom logger writer.
